# Onboarding (`onboarding`)

Step-by-step intro.

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createOnboarding` (types in `dist/web/layout/onboarding.d.ts`): `.mh-onboarding`: a step-by-step intro. A `__skip` button, the `__steps` (one `role="group"` `__step` per entry with `__media`, `__title`, `__text` and `__content`; only the current one shown), a polite `__live` region, and a `__footer` with `__back`, decorative `__dots` (`.is-current`, `.is-done`) and the `__next` button that becomes the done button on the last step. Touch swipes and Left and Right turn the page.

```ts
export function createOnboarding(options: OnboardingOptions): OnboardingHandle;

export interface OnboardingOptions {
  steps: readonly OnboardingStep[];
  /** The step shown first (index, default 0). */
  step?: number;
  labels?: Partial<OnboardingLabels>;
  /** Shows a Skip button (default true). */
  skippable?: boolean;
  /** Heading level of step titles (default 2). */
  headingLevel?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  onStepChange?: (index: number) => void;
  onDone?: () => void;
  onSkip?: () => void;
}

export interface OnboardingHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  step(): number;
  setStep(index: number): void;
  next(): void;
  back(): void;
}

export interface OnboardingLabels {
  /** Accessible name of the whole intro (default "Introduction"). */
  label: string;
  next: string;
  back: string;
  done: string;
  skip: string;
  /** "Step 2 of 4". */
  step(position: number, count: number): string;
}
```

`createSwitch` (types in `dist/web/choice-inputs/switch.d.ts`): `.mh-switch` (`--row` for the settings toggle row): a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`, so Space toggles it and screen readers announce on/off. The track takes the control radius, so square corners give a square switch.

```ts
export function createSwitch(options: SwitchOptions): SwitchHandle;

export interface SwitchOptions {
  /** Visible label. Without one, pass `ariaLabel`. */
  label?: string;
  ariaLabel?: string;
  /** A second line under the label (announced as the description). */
  description?: string;
  checked?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** The settings toggle row: label (and icon) at the start, the switch at the end, full width. */
  row?: boolean;
  /** A leading icon in the row. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  name?: string;
  onChange?: (checked: boolean, event: Event) => void;
}

export interface SwitchHandle {
  el: HTMLLabelElement;
  input: HTMLInputElement;
  isChecked(): boolean;
  setChecked(checked: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createOnboarding, createSwitch, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createText('', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });
const notifications = createSwitch({ label: 'Allow notifications', row: true, checked: true });

const intro = createOnboarding({
  steps: [
    { title: 'Welcome home', text: 'Every room, light and sensor on one screen.', icon: 'home' },
    { title: 'Group by room', text: 'Rooms keep the dashboard short. Reorder them any time.', icon: 'lightbulb' },
    { title: 'Stay in the loop', text: 'Get a gentle chime when a door is left open.', icon: 'bell', content: notifications.el },
  ],
  onStepChange: (index) => (status.textContent = `Step ${index + 1}`),
  onDone: () => (status.textContent = `Done, notifications ${notifications.isChecked() ? 'on' : 'off'}`),
  onSkip: () => (status.textContent = 'Skipped'),
});

document.body.append(intro.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Onboarding, Switch, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function OnboardingExample() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [notify, setNotify] = useState(true);
  const [finished, setFinished] = useState(false);
  if (finished) return <Text>All set. Notifications are {notify ? 'on' : 'off'}.</Text>;
  return (
    <Onboarding
      step={step}
      onStepChange={setStep}
      onDone={() => setFinished(true)}
      onSkip={() => setFinished(true)}
      steps={[
        { title: 'Welcome home', text: 'Every room, light and sensor on one screen.', icon: 'home' },
        { title: 'Group by room', text: 'Rooms keep the dashboard short. Reorder them any time.', icon: 'lightbulb' },
        {
          title: 'Stay in the loop',
          text: 'Get a gentle chime when a door is left open.',
          icon: 'bell',
          content: <Switch label="Allow notifications" row checked={notify} onChange={(e) => setNotify(e.target.checked)} />,
        },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```
